capabilities: Convert links in the current note to their display text
Convert links in the current note to bare URLs
Render bare email addresses as plain text in Reading View and Live Preview
Run conversions from the command palette or ribbon menu
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian renders Markdown links, wiki links, and bare email addresses as clickable, which gets in the way when you want them as plain text.
summary: Link converter that turns Markdown and wiki links in a note into plain text or bare URLs and renders bare email addresses as non-clickable text.
